info.title: API.SH: Xiaohongshu
info.description: The Xiaohongshu API from API.SH: public Xiaohongshu data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The notes on Xiaohongshu's explore page for a channel (about 20-35 per call, a fresh selection each time): note id, xsec_token and link, title, type (normal / video), cover, likes and author (id, nickname, avatar, profile link with its xsec_token), plus the list of channels. The links work with the note and profile endpoints. Keyword search is not offered: Xiaohongshu shows search results to logged-in accounts only. `next_cursor` is always null.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/xiaohongshu-feed

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Explore channel (default recommend).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Xiaohongshu note: title, text, type, publish and edit dates, author, likes, collects, comment and share counts, topic tags, mentioned users, images (with live-photo clips), the video (duration, h264/h265 stream links, first frame) and the top comments with their first replies. Xiaohongshu only opens a note or profile with the `xsec_token` that comes with its link (the site adds it to every link it shows: feeds, share links, the `url` fields of our responses). Pass the whole link as `url`, or the id with `xsec_token`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/xiaohongshu-note

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A xiaohongshu.com note link with its xsec_token (explore/<id>?xsec_token=... or discovery/item/<id>?xsec_token=...).

parameters.name: note_id
parameters.description: Note id (24 hex characters), with xsec_token, instead of url.

parameters.name: xsec_token
parameters.description: The note's xsec_token (from the link), with note_id.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The comments Xiaohongshu shows logged-out visitors on a note: the top comments (usually 5), each with its first replies (up to 3), with text, date, likes, IP location, author, pictures and reply count, plus the note's total and top-level comment counts. Further comments are shown to logged-in accounts only, so `next_cursor` is always null (`has_more` tells whether more exist). Xiaohongshu only opens a note or profile with the `xsec_token` that comes with its link (the site adds it to every link it shows: feeds, share links, the `url` fields of our responses). Pass the whole link as `url`, or the id with `xsec_token`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/xiaohongshu-note-comments

get.description:
The transcript of a Xiaohongshu video note, from the captions the site publishes for the video: timed segments (start and end in seconds, text), the whole text, the SRT file, and the caption tracks available (the original speech and its translations, e.g. zh-CN and en-US). A video the site publishes no captions for is transcribed from its own audio (`track` "ai", `source` "ai", in the language spoken); a video without speech answers 404. Xiaohongshu only opens a note with the `xsec_token` that comes with its link (feeds, share links, the `url` fields of our responses): pass the whole link as `url`, or the id with `xsec_token`. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/xiaohongshu-note-transcript

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A xiaohongshu.com note link with its xsec_token.

parameters.name: note_id
parameters.description: Note id (24 hex characters), with xsec_token, instead of url.

parameters.name: xsec_token
parameters.description: The note's xsec_token (from the link), with note_id.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Caption track: source (the original speech, the default) or a language such as zh-CN or en-US.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Xiaohongshu profile's posts as logged-out visitors see them (the first 30 or so): title, type, cover, likes, pinned flag, publish date and xsec_token. Xiaohongshu leaves out the note ids in this list for visitors (`note_id` and `url` are null), and lists further posts to logged-in accounts only, so `next_cursor` is always null. Xiaohongshu only opens a profile with the `xsec_token` that comes with its link (the site adds it to every link it shows: feeds, share links, the `url` fields of our responses). Pass the whole link as `url`, or the id with `xsec_token`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/xiaohongshu-user-notes

parameters.description: A xiaohongshu.com profile link with its xsec_token (user/profile/<id>?xsec_token=...).

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: User id (24 hex characters), with xsec_token, instead of url.

parameters.name: xsec_token
parameters.description: The profile's xsec_token (from the link), with user_id.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
